text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ

words.gloss_range: consequential interrogative opening that turns prior denial into rebuke
words.prose: The opening {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) fuses challenge with consequence. Before any object is named, the ayah is already prosecuting failed attention as the next answer to the prior denial, so the sky-earth scene will function as evidence against refusal rather than as neutral scenery.

topics.headline: consequential rebuke frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a rebuke generated by the prior discourse, not as a detached request for information.
topics.reason: The aligned word is the interrogative hamza with prefixed consequence/resumption particle, and the CRITICAL rows coherently tie it to the boundary from 34:8 into 34:9.

words.gloss_range: past-negating jussive particle marking expected perception as already failed
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes the act of seeing an expected act already missed. Its scope stays on the following verb, while the later condition opens a new frame; the rebuke first establishes failed perception before the threat sequence begins.

topics.headline: expected seeing already failed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is treated as already blameworthy before the cosmic evidence is unfolded.
topics.reason: The jussive negator governs the following imperfect verb and does not govern the later conditional threat clause.

words.gloss_range: directed seeing that includes visual attention and judgment under negated collective failure
words.root_gloss_range: visual perception, seeing-as-judgment, and considered recognition; local use is directed scrutiny toward evidence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition directing seeing toward a field
sign named near closure as the answer to failed seeing

words.prose: {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}) is not simple eyesight with an object; with {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ila}}), it demands aimed scrutiny of an evidentiary field. The plural jussive makes the failure collective, and the ayah later answers this failed seeing with {{ar:ءَايَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ayatan}}), turning vision into a test of sign-reading rather than mere looking.

topics.headline: directed perception must become sign-reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the rebuke is about refused inference from visible evidence, not a lack of available objects.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive plural under the negator and is locally directed by the following preposition toward the surrounding field; the closing sign noun confirms the perception-to-recognition arc.

words.gloss_range: preposition of orientation directing attention toward the evidence field
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ila}}) turns the seeing verb toward a field that must be faced. It foregrounds orientation before content, so the problem is not that nothing is visible but that attention refuses to move toward what is already around them.

topics.headline: orientation before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah rebukes misdirected attention before it lists the field of evidence.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative object and fits the CRITICAL claim that sight is aimed toward an evidentiary domain.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening an expandable non-personal evidence field
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) leaves the seen object unnamed so the field can expand. What lies before them, what is behind them, and the sky-earth domain are gathered as one open arena of evidence rather than reduced to a single spectacle.

topics.headline: expandable field of evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of attention is deliberately broad, allowing ordinary surroundings to become evidence.
topics.reason: The local grammar identifies the word as a relative pronoun governed by the preposition, and the following spatial phrases fill out its range.

words.gloss_range: relational interval before them, carrying both spatial nearness and clarity pressure
words.root_gloss_range: interval, separation, distinction, disclosure, and clarification; local noun selects the spatial interval with evidentiary clarity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) is a relational noun in construct with their hands, so the evidence is measured from their own position. Its root field lets the near interval feel like something that should become clear: the space before them is not inert space but a readable part of the proof field.

topics.headline: near interval with clarity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the space directly before them is both physically near and semantically pressed toward clarity.
topics.reason: The local form is an adverbial relational noun in construct, so spatial interval is selected; explanatory branches remain as pressure toward evidentiary clarity rather than replacing the local sense.

words.gloss_range: their hands as the forward/reach zone of embodied accountability
words.root_gloss_range: hand, possession, agency, power, and what lies within reach; local plural suffix anchors the front zone to the accused group
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:aydihim}}) anchors the first spatial pole in their own embodied reach. The possessive plural makes the ignored sign intimate: the evidence begins where their own agency and forward field are indexed, then expands outward to the whole sky-earth frame.

topics.headline: their reach becomes evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence starts in the addressees own reach before expanding to cosmic scale.
topics.reason: The broken plural with possessive suffix resumes the same group and supports the CRITICAL movement from body-centered front space to wider accountability.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that gives the rearward field its own parallel slot
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second relative field additive and balanced. The rear is not collapsed into the first phrase; it receives its own surface onset while remaining under the same obligation of perception.

topics.headline: balanced second field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that front and rear are paired as a totalizing frame, not listed as loose examples.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the second spatial object phrase and preserves the parallel construction.

words.gloss_range: second relative pronoun completing the parallel front/rear evidence field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first relative pronoun that establishes the parallel parse

words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) is best read in parallel with the first relative {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), despite the raw tag issue in the bundle. It balances the rearward field with the forward one, forcing the audience to treat multiple unnamed zones as one structured field of evidence.

topics.headline: relative reading completes symmetry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rearward phrase is part of the same object of seeing, not a negation that would break the frame.
topics.reason: The qac-compatible grammar notes that the bundle tag says negative particle, but the local context supports relative force coordinated with the first relative pronoun.

words.gloss_range: their rear/behind field, including spatial backness and aftermath pressure
words.root_gloss_range: behind, remaining after, succession, replacement, and difference; local noun selects rearward space with aftermath pressure
words.prose: {{ar:خَلْفَهُم}} ({{tr:khalfahum}}) closes the horizontal frame around the same plural group. Locally it names the rear, while the root family adds aftermath and succession pressure: what is behind them is also a field of consequence they fail to read.

topics.headline: rear field with aftermath pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rear is both a spatial direction and a consequence-laden part of the enclosure around the deniers.
topics.reason: The adverbial noun with suffix selects the rear relative to their stance; succession and aftermath remain valid root pressure without replacing the local spatial sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition specifying the surrounding field as drawn from the sky-earth domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) pivots the sentence from body-centered front and rear into the cosmic domain. The missed field is specified as drawn from sky and earth, so ordinary orientation is widened into total environment.

topics.headline: from front-rear to sky-earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the expansion from local orientation to cosmic scale happens through this small prepositional pivot.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the sky-earth phrase as explanatory/source domain for the surrounding evidence.

words.gloss_range: the known upper realm in the observed sky-earth field, later reused as threat source
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, upperness, and visible upper expanse; local noun selects the definite sky with marking/sign pressure only as background
words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samai}}) names the known upper realm as part of the field they should read. Its height is not abstract: it pairs with the earth as a merism, then returns later as the source from which fragments may fall.

topics.headline: known upper pole becomes readable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sky first appears as observed evidence and is later reversed into a possible source of danger.
topics.reason: The definite genitive noun after the preposition selects the upper realm; derivational marking pressure is kept as sign-readability background, not as a replacement for sky.

words.gloss_range: conjunction binding sky and earth into one vertical totality
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) yokes the high and low poles without making them separate examples. Sky and earth become one surrounding field, which the conditional threats will divide into danger from below and danger from above.

topics.headline: sky-earth as one totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sky and earth form the ayah’s vertical totality rather than two unrelated objects.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two definite nouns into a conventional high-low pair.

words.gloss_range: the definite earth as observed lower support before its role shifts into acted object
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, support, and habitation; local genitive noun names the observed lower pole before threat reversal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same earth repeated as accusative object of sinking

words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ardi}}) completes the visible vertical pair as stable lower support. That stability is temporary in the argument: the same earth will return as {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arda}}), the acted object of sinking, so scenery becomes an instrument of vulnerability.

topics.headline: support becomes threat medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role shift: the ground first appears as environment and then as the medium of collapse.
topics.reason: The first earth is genitive in the observed field, while the later accusative earth is object of the sinking verb; the repeated noun supports the CRITICAL echo.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle suspending the threats under divine will
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the threat as possible capability, not as an event already narrated. The condition makes cosmic stability contingent while saving the final sign claim for a different, emphatic frame.

topics.headline: suspended threat capability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threats are held as open capability under will, not as immediate occurrence.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the following jussive protasis and apodosis, and contrasts with the later emphatic particle.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural willing that governs the two threatened outcomes
words.root_gloss_range: willing, intending, specifying a thing or event; local verb makes the destructive outcomes contingent on divine volition
words.prose: {{ar:نَشَأْ}} ({{tr:nasha}}) places both mechanisms under one act of will. The object of willing is left to be supplied by the two following threats, so earth-sinking and sky-fall are not autonomous natural processes but selectable outcomes under divine discretion.

topics.headline: one will governs two mechanisms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the natural mechanisms are subordinate to divine decision before either one is named.
topics.reason: The jussive protasis verb after the conditional particle governs both coordinated apodoses; accepted person-shift variants preserve the same threat architecture.

words.gloss_range: jussive sinking/collapsing action making the earth the acted medium and the people carried within it
words.root_gloss_range: sinking, subsiding, swallowing, collapse, and eclipse-like disappearance; local verb selects earth-sinking under divine agency

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition marking involved victims in the sinking event
plural pronoun for the affected group

words.prose: {{ar:نَخْسِفْ}} ({{tr:nakhsif}}) makes the lower support fail under agency. The grammar separates the earth as the direct object from the people carried with the event through {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}){{ar:هِمُ}} ({{tr:himu}}), so the ground is the acted medium and they are caught inside its collapse.

topics.headline: support disappears downward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat is not generic disaster but the known ground being made to swallow or subside with them.
topics.reason: The verb is a jussive apodosis with earth as object and the people in a prepositional phrase; the root and recurrence field support sinking or swallowing without making the collapse self-caused.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition marking the people as involved victims within the subsidence
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) ties the people into the sinking event as affected accompaniment. They are not merely watching the ground collapse; the compact prepositional bond carries them with the subsidence before the earth is named.

topics.headline: victims carried with collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first threat embeds the people inside the earth-event rather than placing them outside it.
topics.reason: The preposition is attached to the plural pronoun and precedes the earth object, matching the CRITICAL account of affected involvement.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun continuing the accused group into the threat
words.prose: {{ar:هِمُ}} ({{tr:himu}}) keeps the same group in view without renaming them. The observers whose hands and rear defined the evidence field now become participants in the first threat, and the pronoun will recur again in the overhead danger.

topics.headline: observers become threatened participants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one referent chain from failed observation into vulnerability.
topics.reason: The suffixal plural pronoun resumes the group from the opening verb and possessive forms, maintaining continuity across observation and threat.

words.gloss_range: the known earth as accusative object of sinking, turning support into acted hazard
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, support, and habitation; local accusative noun names the known ground as object of destabilizing action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: sinking verb governing the earth as object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arda}}) is the same known ground now placed as the object of {{ar:نَخْسِفْ}} ({{tr:nakhsif}}). What supported and surrounded them becomes the medium acted upon beneath them; the case shift from the earlier earth makes the environment itself enter the threat.

topics.headline: support becomes object of collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same earth moves from stable scenery to the acted substrate of punishment.
topics.reason: The accusative definite noun is the direct object of the sinking verb, while the people are affected through the prepositional phrase.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive conjunction coordinating alternative lower and upper threat outcomes
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) branches the single condition into two vertical alternatives. The threat does not require both outcomes; vulnerability is total because danger can come through the earth beneath or from the sky above.

topics.headline: either below or above
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah widens vulnerability by offering alternative vectors rather than a single disaster.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two jussive apodoses under one condition and mirrors the vertical sky-earth field.

words.gloss_range: causative jussive causing a concrete sky fragment to fall onto them
words.root_gloss_range: falling, descent from position, loss of standing, and being made to drop; local Form IV selects caused descent from above

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: target phrase under the falling object

words.prose: {{ar:نُسْقِطْ}} ({{tr:nusqit}}) completes the upper threat as deliberate caused descent. It takes {{ar:كِسَفًۭا}} ({{tr:kisafan}}) as the object made to fall and {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:alayhim}}) as the target beneath it, so the sky-fragment does not fall by accident and the same group is exposed from above.

topics.headline: causative sky-fall threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the upper threat is an imposed descent of concrete material, not an accidental fall.
topics.reason: The Form IV jussive is coordinated under the same condition and distinguishes the falling object from the target phrase; person-shift variants preserve the paired threat alignment.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun placing the group beneath the falling fragment as target

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition of involved accompaniment in the first threat
same plural group in the first threat

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:alayhim}}) changes the victim relation from embeddedness to overhead targeting. In the first threat the people are carried with collapse through {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}){{ar:هِمُ}} ({{tr:himu}}); here the same group is placed under the descending object.

topics.headline: beneath the falling object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two threats map the same people into two different vertical relations: carried in collapse and struck from above.
topics.reason: The preposition with the plural suffix marks target position under the falling object and contrasts locally with the earlier prepositional phrase.

words.gloss_range: indefinite concrete fragment or pieces from the sky, with variant pressure between pieces and one mass
words.root_gloss_range: fragmenting, pieces, covering, obscuring, and detached portions; local noun selects concrete sky-fragment material
words.prose: {{ar:كِسَفًۭا}} ({{tr:kisafan}}) makes the upper threat materially specific. The indefinite accusative does not name which fragment, but it keeps the object concrete; variant pressure between pieces and a single mass leaves the threat as detachable sky-material rather than a vague calamity.

topics.headline: unspecified but concrete fragment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines not generic sky danger but concrete pieces or a mass detached from above.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative object of the causative fall verb; accepted variant shape affects plurality or massing while preserving the concrete fragment field.

words.gloss_range: partitive/source preposition separating the fragment from the sky
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) marks the fragment as drawn from the sky, not merely falling through it. The syntax separates a piece from a larger upper whole, making the sky itself divisible under the threat.

topics.headline: fragment sourced from sky
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sky becomes the source material of the falling object.
topics.reason: The preposition follows the fragment object and governs the sky as its source domain.

words.gloss_range: the definite sky repeated as source of falling material rather than observed upper pole
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, upperness, and visible upper expanse; local repetition makes the upper realm source of descent
words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samai}}) repeats the sky with a changed role. What first belonged to the observation field now supplies the fragment, so height is reversed into descent and the threat clause closes on the upper pole before the sign conclusion.

topics.headline: observed sky becomes source sky
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same sky moves from something to read above them to something that may send material down on them.
topics.reason: The definite genitive noun is governed by the source preposition after the fragment object, and its repetition links observation and threat while preserving height as the selected sense.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle introducing the settled sign claim after conditional threats
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) shifts the ayah from suspended possibility to asserted interpretation. The threats remain conditional, but their sign-value is no longer tentative; the final clause tells the resistant listener what the scene certainly is.

topics.headline: conditional threat becomes certain sign claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot from possible events to settled meaning.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle opens the concluding nominal clause and contrasts with the earlier conditional particle.

words.gloss_range: fronted preposition locating signhood inside the gathered prior scene
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) makes the prior sequence a container of meaning. By fronting the phrase before the sign noun, the wording makes the listener gather failed seeing, enclosure, and threat as the place where signhood is found.

topics.headline: signhood inside the whole scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is located inside the whole prior complex, not attached to only one object.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces a fronted predicate phrase before the delayed noun, matching the container relation described by the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative gathering the full preceding observation-threat complex into one object of reflection
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhalika}}) points back to the whole sequence as one interpretable complex. Its distance lets the immediate threat stand back for reflection, and its singular form compresses seeing, enclosure, and the two threats into one sign-bearing object.

topics.headline: whole scene gathered into one pointer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is the whole argument taken together, not a single isolated item.
topics.reason: The masculine singular demonstrative can gather the prior discourse complex and is resolved by the delayed sign noun.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām fused to the delayed sign noun, reinforcing certainty with the earlier emphatic particle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier emphatic particle in the double frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) attaches emphasis directly to the coming sign noun. Together with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), it makes the final claim answer failed seeing with certainty: the evidence is not weak, but reception is the problem.

topics.headline: certainty of signhood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure insists on signhood rather than merely proposing a possible lesson.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle is attached to the predicate noun and reinforces the earlier emphatic particle in the nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: an emphatically marked singular sign: one integrated configuration of visible world, threat, and interpretation
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, indicator, and readable token; contested return pressure may color reception but local sense selects signhood

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening seeing verb completed by sign-reading
returning servant who can receive the sign

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ayatan}}) finally names what the preceding material is: one readable sign. Its singularity makes the entire configuration sufficient, while the opening {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}) returns here as sign-reading. The contested return-pressure is locally narrowed: it deepens the fit with {{ar:مُّنِيبٍۢ}} ({{tr:munibin}}), but the selected sense remains sign or marker.

topics.headline: one integrated sign resolves the sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole sky-earth threat sequence is named as one sufficient sign for a receptive servant.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite singular under emphatic marking; the root evidence supports sign/marker locally, while the contested return association is preserved only as pressure toward the final recipient term.

words.gloss_range: preposition routing the certain sign toward its effective recipient class
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) routes the sign toward those who can use it. The evidence may be visible broadly, but the benefit is directed to the qualified class that follows, so the final claim distinguishes availability from uptake.

topics.headline: sign directed to qualified recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certain signhood does not mean automatic reception by everyone.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following totality phrase and marks benefit or suitability for the returning servant class.

words.gloss_range: construct totality distributing inclusion across every member of the qualified servant class
words.root_gloss_range: allness, totality, entirety, and exhaustive inclusion; local construct totalizes only the qualified phrase that follows
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) opens wide, but only inside the phrase it governs. It includes every instance of the servant characterized by return, not every observer without qualification; the form balances generous evidence with morally specified reception.

topics.headline: every member of a narrowed class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final universality is exhaustive within a qualified class, not unrestricted human reception.
topics.reason: The noun of totality is genitive after the preposition and in construct with the servant noun, while the following adjective bounds the class.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular servant as open but qualified receptive identity
words.root_gloss_range: servitude, worshipful dependence, service, and tractable formed posture; local noun names a servant identity qualified by return
words.prose: {{ar:عَبْدٍ}} ({{tr:abdin}}) names the sign-reader by standing identity rather than by a single act. Under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) it is open to any servant of this kind, but the following {{ar:مُّنِيبٍۢ}} ({{tr:munibin}}) locks the category to return; cosmic evidence reaches one who stands dependently enough to receive it.

topics.headline: servitude as qualified receptivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign benefits a servantly identity shaped by return, not an unnamed elite or an unrestricted crowd.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite singular in construct under totality and is qualified by the matching adjective; road/tractability imagery remains posture pressure rather than replacing the servant sense.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle describing a habitually returning servant as the final condition of uptake
words.root_gloss_range: return, recurrence, turning back, and reorientation; local participle selects an enduring active disposition of return
words.prose: {{ar:مُّنِيبٍۢ}} ({{tr:munibin}}) is the ayah’s final word and controls reception of the whole scene. As a Form IV active participle, it makes return an enduring active posture, not a momentary scare response; evidence, threat, and emphatic signhood land on the servant disposed to turn back.

topics.headline: returning posture controls uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decisive contrast is failed non-returning sight versus sign-reading by a servant habitually turned back.
topics.reason: The active participle agrees with the servant noun and closes the ayah, while inter-ayah echoes such as 50:33 and 50:8 support returning disposition as the reception key.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question joins seeing with what lies before and behind them from the sky and the earth, then calls the whole configuration a sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Front and rear are filled out by the upper and lower bounds, turning ordinary location into a completely surrounding field of visible evidence rather than a remote spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Joins ocular perception and insight, making the opening question a demand to recognize what is already perceptible.
Supplies the interval occupied by what is immediately in front of the observers.
Makes the hands-construction denote the forward, approaching, or near field.
Adds the rearward field opposed to what is in front.
Provides the overhead canopy and source of the second threatened motion.
Provides the lower counterpart to the sky and the support that can become a sink.
Classifies this encompassing arrangement as an outwardly available mark.

changed_reading.before: They are asked to notice the sky and earth around them.
changed_reading.after: They occupy a front-to-back and above-to-below evidentiary enclosure; failure to see is failure of recognition amid an already visible sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional pairs causing the earth to sink with making a detached piece of sky fall upon them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two stable bounds can reverse their usual supporting and sheltering roles: the lower bound opens downward while material from the upper bound descends, closing both vertical exits under one act of will.

activation_trace.role: Makes the paired reversals contingent on will directed toward an object or event.
Supplies the ground's downward recession and swallowing motion.
Turns the ordinarily lower support into the medium of descent.
Supplies imposed downward fall from the opposite bound.
Makes what falls a separated portion rather than an undifferentiated sky.
Turns the overhead shelter into the source of descending matter.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two alternative punishments.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives form one coordinated vertical trap: support below and shelter above are both reversible under divine will.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sign is specified for every servant described as munib.
baseline_models.mechanism: Servanthood supplies receptive obedience while inabah supplies repeated return; together they describe the posture that converts a surrounding fact into a personally legible sign.

activation_trace.role: Extends the stated availability of the sign to each member of the receptive class.
Supplies yielding obedience as the perceiver's relation to the sign-giver.
Supplies recurrent return as the motion by which attention is repeatedly reoriented.

changed_reading.before: Munib is a general commendatory adjective attached to the believer.
changed_reading.after: Returning servanthood is the verse's perceptual mechanism: repeated reorientation makes the enclosing world readable as a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first describes regular traffic into and out of earth and down from and up through sky. The focus threats invert that open circulation into one-way capture: entry becomes engulfment and descent becomes impact.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed model in the focus ayah's downward recession of ground.
Anchors the changed model in the focus ayah's imposed fall from above.
Supplies ordinary penetration into earth as one leg of the open system.
Supplies emergence to the exterior as the counterflow normally paired with entry.
Supplies normal downward arrival from the sky, whose direction the threat intensifies.
Supplies ascent as the open counter-direction that disappears in the threatened closure.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges earth-entry/earth-exit and sky-descent/sky-ascent as two balanced pairs.
34:9 preserves the same earth-sky axis but gives each bound a destructive downward vector.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four normal directional flows and two threatened downward motions; I infer a reversal from circulation to capture. The live alternative is that 34:2 only inventories divine knowledge and does not define a physical system.

changed_reading.before: The earth-sinking and sky-fall are isolated catastrophic possibilities.
changed_reading.after: They are punitive reversals of the surah's normally open earth-sky circulation, converting exchange into inescapable one-way descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, mockers equate total bodily tearing with the impossibility of new creation. The focus answers materially rather than abstractly: even the sky can be cut into portions and the earth can lose continuity, so apparent wholeness is not an independent limit on disassembly or renewed making.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in cutting a portion from a larger whole.
Makes the threatened object an actually separated piece of the encompassing sky.
Supplies the skeptics' image of a body torn and dispersed into pieces.
Places creative origination on the far side of the imagined disassembly.
Supplies new occurrence after a prior cutting, linking rupture to renewed creation.

structural_cues: 34:7 places total tearing and new creation in one skeptical sentence.
34:9 follows with earth discontinuity and a separated sky-piece.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mocked bodily partition, renewed creation, and divisible cosmic bounds; I infer that the focus threat undercuts the premise that integrity makes recreation impossible. Alternatively, the proximity may serve only as a change from resurrection polemic to punishment warning.

changed_reading.before: The falling sky-piece is only an image of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic partition also answers the preceding incredulity: if the containing world is divisible by will, bodily disassembly cannot set the measure of creative power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to the mountains to return with David gives return a responsive, repeated, and even environmental form. Munib can therefore be heard not only as private repentance but as participation in a world that answers a summons by turning back.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the perceiver in obedient service.
Anchors munib in recurrent return toward a point of orientation.
Supplies a commanded return shared by David's surrounding mountains, making response spatial and recurrent.

structural_cues: 34:10 addresses mountains and includes birds in the answering movement around David.
34:9 locates the returning servant inside a sky-earth surround.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct roots with convergent return images and an imperative addressed to creation; I infer responsive resonance between creation and the munib servant. The alternative is loose semantic echo without a functional link.

changed_reading.before: The returning servant is an inwardly repentant individual who notices a sign.
changed_reading.after: The returning servant is also a responsive participant: like the surrounding creation commanded to return, the servant repeatedly answers and thereby reads the surround.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's sequence makes hard metal soft, then submits linked construction to measure and ordered continuity. This supplies a local material grammar for the focus: hardness, support, continuity, and partition are directed properties, so earth can recess and sky can separate without being autonomous fixed limits.

activation_trace.role: Anchors changes of the cosmic media in a will directed toward an event.
Provides loss of continuity and level in the lower material bound.
Provides cutting or partition in the upper material bound.
Supplies the reversal of hardness into workable softness.
Supplies resistant iron as the material whose fixed-seeming property is changed.
Supplies deliberate measure governing how transformed material is arranged.
Supplies ordered continuity between linked parts, the inverse of the focus ayah's separation.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from softening iron to measuring its linked construction.
34:9 moves from stable cosmic bounds to recession and detached pieces under will.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one explicit case of hardness made pliable and continuity deliberately measured; I extend that material logic to the focus ayah's earth and sky. The alternative is that David's craft is a bounded miracle with no implied cosmic material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Earth and sky are fixed scenery interrupted by miracles.
changed_reading.after: They are directed media whose level, hardness, continuity, and partition are no less contingent than the softened and measured material later in the surah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solomon's apparently stable posture is secretly being undermined by an earth-creature consuming its support; the eventual fall makes hidden ignorance manifest. That sequence turns the focus's sinking and falling into disclosure-events: collapse does not merely destroy an arrangement but exposes the false knowledge that depended on its appearance of stability.

activation_trace.role: Anchors disclosure in the lower support receding beneath its occupants.
Anchors disclosure in an imposed fall from a previously stable position.
Makes the resulting event readable rather than merely destructive.
Activates the earth-root's wood-eating creature image as the hidden agent that removes a support.
Supplies incremental consumption of the staff on which the visible arrangement depends.
Supplies the noisy, destabilizing fall that ends the false appearance.
Makes the consequence of collapse an emergence into clarity: the jinn's limitation becomes manifest.

structural_cues: In 34:14 hidden erosion precedes a sudden fall, and the fall precedes recognition of ignorance.
In 34:9 both threatened motions terminate in an ayah, explicitly assigning evidentiary force to collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support-consumption, fall, and subsequent manifestation; I infer the arrow collapse -> disclosure and apply it to the focus threats. The live alternative is that 34:14's disclosure concerns only the jinn's unseen knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Sinking and falling visibly punish bodies.
changed_reading.after: They also break epistemic supports: a collapse can expose how much confidence rested on an unread, unstable surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Saba's dwelling, flanking gardens, visible towns, measured routes, and safe travel instantiate an inhabitable directional field. Flood, substitution, demanded distance, and scattering then reverse it. The focus surround is thus not only a threat-zone: its ordinary continuity is a maintained sign whose revocation converts nearness into distance and habitation into dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the occupied interval directly around the observer.
Anchors the accessible forward and near direction.
Completes the inhabited field with its rearward direction.
Allows the normal surround, not only catastrophe, to function as an outward sign.
Supplies settled habitation as the starting state of the spatial system.
Supplies one lateral flank of the inhabited field.
Supplies the opposite lateral flank, completing a directional enclosure around the settlement.
Supplies the flowing force that overturns the settled landscape.
Makes ecological reversal a change in the landscape's very form.
Supplies settlements visibly disclosed along the route.
Supplies continuous movement through the maintained corridor.
Supplies secure confidence as the lived effect of that spatial continuity.
Supplies the requested production of distance that negates accessible nearness.
Supplies final spatial dispersal into separated pieces.

structural_cues: 34:15 marks a dwelling with productive space on right and left.
34:18 measures a chain of visible settlements for safe movement by night and day.
34:16 and 34:19 reverse fertility, proximity, continuity, and social cohesion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secure directional corridor and its historical reversal; I infer that the stable everyday surround in 34:9 is itself the sign before either threatened catastrophe occurs. Alternatively, the Saba sequence may be an independent historical exemplum rather than an expansion of the focus topology.

changed_reading.before: The sign consists chiefly in the possibility of extraordinary cosmic punishment.
changed_reading.after: The presently continuous, traversable surround is already a maintained sign; sinking, flood, distance, and scattering are coordinated ways that inhabitable continuity can be withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's close, seeing finally occurs amid panic, but escape has elapsed, seizure comes from a near place, attempted reaching comes from far away, and a barrier is installed between people and desire. This makes the focus question a temporal opening: see the surrounding sign and return while recognition can still alter direction.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the present demand for perceptive recognition.
Anchors the available response in recurrent return before closure.
Supplies a later scene in which sight coincides with panic rather than corrective insight.
Removes the possibility of getting beyond or reaching an escape.
Supplies capture that turns the threatened enclosure into an accomplished seizure.
Places that capture in the near field, answering the focus's immediately surrounding space.
Supplies an attempted reaching whose extension can no longer attain its object.
Locates belated reach at disabling distance from what is now desired.
Supplies an intervening barrier that converts surrounding space into separation.
Makes the interval between people and their object an imposed severance.
Names the desired object from which the late perceivers are cut off.

structural_cues: 34:9 opens with failed seeing and ends with the servant who repeatedly returns.
34:51-54 orders late sight, no escape, near capture, failed distant reach, and final interposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an early demand to see and a late scene of sight after agency has collapsed; I infer that 34:9 marks a preventable interval for reorientation. The alternative is that the two seeing scenes intensify warning without defining a temporal opportunity structure.

changed_reading.before: The opening rebuke asks for observation, and munib simply names the righteous audience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is an actionable interval: perceptive return is possible now, whereas the surah's final sight arrives inside near capture and irreversible separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the sky-root to a root of visible marking, so it is form-distant and must not replace the direct sense of sky. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's repeated sky and explicit ayah: the split branch lets the canopy itself act as a marked surface, and prose should label this a lexical activation rather than a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same sky that surrounds them can yield a cut-off piece, and the verse immediately names the configuration an ayah.

activation_trace.role: Activates a visible identifying mark within the packet's alternate mapping of the repeated sky-root.
Lets a portion be cut from the marked encompassing surface.
Confirms that the resulting configuration functions as an outward mark.

changed_reading.before: The sky is an overhead object that may shed a punitive fragment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the canopy is also a sign-bearing surface: a detached piece makes the surrounding world's markedness violently explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's alternate mapping of the seeing-root to a massive rain-cloud branch and is therefore deliberately branch-distant. The sky-piece, falling motion, and later flood keep it physically anchored, but downstream prose should present atmospheric mass or cloudburst only as a possible image, never as the lexical replacement for kisf.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Seeing, sky, falling kisf, and the surah's destructive flood can be aligned as an atmospheric-discharge image.

activation_trace.role: Activates the form-distant image of a massive, hard-falling rain cloud at the act of seeing.
Keeps the activated mass located in the overhead canopy named by the focus ayah.
Anchors the image in a separated mass from the sky rather than free-floating weather imagery.
Supplies the surah's realized destructive torrent as a material analogue for atmospheric discharge.

changed_reading.before: Kisf is imagined only as a solid shard of the sky.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also evoke an oppressive sky-mass discharging as catastrophic weather, with Saba's torrent showing the earthward consequence.

strongest_changes: 34:2 turns the paired threats into a reversal of normal earth-sky circulation.
34:14 makes collapse evidentiary: hidden support failure exposes hidden ignorance.
34:15-19 makes ordinary habitable continuity itself a sign whose reversal yields distance and dispersal.
34:51-54 turns the opening demand to see into a time-sensitive opportunity for return before near capture and separation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly makes boundaries responsive rather than inert: matter softens and is measured, supports are consumed, settlements and routes are reconfigured, and late distance becomes a barrier. Against that pattern, munib also resonates with the commanded returning response of the mountains.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between David's awb and the munib servant may be functional resonance rather than deliberate lexical linkage.
The directed-material model may overgeneralize from David's bounded craft to cosmic media.
The sky-mark and cloudburst readings rely on non-dominant mapped roots and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **“Before” and “behind” become a surrounding load-bearing field.** `ي د ي/B008` is “before the hands,” `خ ل ف/B002` behind, `خ س ف/B001` ground sinking, and `ك س ف/B004` a detached piece from sky or body. The spatial pair encloses the observers before the alternatives remove support below or detach material above. Front/back establishes total exposure; sinking and falling test the two boundaries. The packet gives enclosure and alternatives; I infer a load-bearing relation between the human position and the two domains. The sign is thus not distant scenery but the contingency of the very field holding them.
2. **Return is the perceptual condition.** `ن و ب/B001` is habitual return. Its participial close assigns repeated turning-back to the servant who can read the surrounding field as a sign. I infer that recurrence corrects ordinary visual habituation. The ayah reads sight as revisitable attention, not a one-time glance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:18-19 turned surrounding space into measured infrastructure and then rupture; 34:51 finally collapsed all imagined distance into near capture.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Collapse by imperceptible undermining.** `ء ر ض B010` supplies the wood-eating termite. The fixed ayah threatens ground-sinking, while 34:14, exactly at the far edge of its focus window, has an earth-creature eat a staff until the supported body falls. The branch gives the earth a micro-causal role inside the larger collapse image. The packet supplies both collapses; I infer that slow internal consumption can realize the same loss of support as sudden subsidence. `نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ` thus includes a surprising scale range, from geological engulfment to almost invisible structural failure.

2. **The overhead cover reversed into a projectile.** `س م و B004` supplies sky as overhead cover, while `ك س ف B004` supplies a detached piece of sky or body. Front and behind are enclosed by sky and earth, then the lower surface may sink and the upper cover may detach and fall. The branches assign the environment a reversible containing role. The packet supplies the geometry; I infer that the sign consists in every apparent refuge becoming an exposure. The ayah reads as a no-exit spatial envelope rather than two unrelated threats.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:14 was the strongest bounded surprise in the opening window. Its earth-creature quietly consumes a support before collapse, directly activating `ء ر ض B010` and correcting an exclusively sudden or geological reading of 34:9.

baseline.text: Önlerindeki ve arkalarındaki göğe ve yere bakmadılar mı? Dilersek onları yere batırır veya üzerlerine gökten parçalar düşürürüz. Bunda Rabbine yönelen her kul için elbette bir işaret vardır.

findings.text: Ön ve arka ile yer ve gök, insanı taşıyan kuşatıcı bir alan oluşturur; aşağıdaki dayanağın batması veya yukarıdaki örtünün kopup düşmesi, bu alanın sığınak olmaktan çıkabileceğini gösterir.
İşareti görebilmek, bir defalık bakıştan çok, alışkanlığın körleştirdiği çevreye tekrar tekrar dönmeyi gerektirir.
Yere batmanın, asayı içten kemiren küçük bir yer canlısı gibi fark edilmez bir yapısal aşınmayla gerçekleşebileceği okuması ölçek bakımından ilginç, ancak ayetler arası benzetmeye fazla bağımlıdır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A concealed condition becomes publicly legible when an enclosing surface or load-bearing support fails.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Threatened cosmic fracture and the quiet erosion of a staff share a disclosure logic: structural failure converts what was denied or unknown into visible evidence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Enclosure Breached From Below or Above
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Stable habitation is pressured by two opposed failures, ground subsidence below and detached canopy fragments falling from above.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earth subsidence (`quranic:root_000410:B001/m01`), cutting apart (`quranic:root_001298:B001/m01`), detached fragment (`quranic:root_001298:B004/m01`), downward fall (`quranic:root_000719:B001/m01`), visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The earth and sky cease to be passive scenery and become vulnerable boundaries around the observer. Either breach would turn the surrounding structure itself into a sign.
